pricing_faq_q1: Xana ku vekiwa minxavo hi riendzo kumbe hi xitulu xa vatirhi?
pricing_faq_a1: Titiers leti kandziyisiweke i ntlawa wun’wana na wun’wana wa xibedlhele lowu nga na swifunengeto swa xibedlhele na switulu. Cloud na On-premise share Starter, Bindzu, Xikalo, na Pulatifomo. Nxaxamelo wa n’hweti na n’hweti eka ndhawu i Cloud + $150. Ku hava movha wun’wana na wun’wana lowu tirhisaka mitara ya ku endzela yin’wana na yin’wana leyi spike hi masiku yo khomeka.
pricing_faq_q2: Ha yini lembe na lembe u hlayisa 20%?
pricing_faq_a2: Ku hakela ka lembe na lembe ku khiya eka lembe leri nga languteriwaka ra Medora. Loomline-style hospital SaaS yi tala ku hunguta tipulani ta lembe na lembe kwalomu ka 15 ku ya eka 20%. Medora yi tirhisa 20% eka nxaxamelo wa n’hweti na n’hweti loko u hakela lembe na lembe, eka havumbirhi bya Cloud na On-premise (endzhaku ka +$150 On-premise premium).
pricing_faq_q3: Xana mimojula ya inventory na ya tliliniki ya katsiwile?
pricing_faq_a3: Starter yi katsa ku tsarisiwa ka nkoka, maendzo, na ti workbench ta tliliniki leti nga na inventory ya xisekelo. Mabindzu na le henhla ya pfula maendlelo ya ntirho ya nhundzu leyi heleleke, tioda ta mirhi leti hlanganisiweke na xitoko, na vukorhokeri bya admin lebyi fuweke. Vutisa loko u lava swiengetelo leswi lawuriwaka.
pricing_faq_q4: Minxavo ya misava hinkwayo vs Myanmar?
pricing_faq_a4: Tirhisa market toggle ehenhla ka tipulani. Global yi kombisa USD ntsena. Myanmar yi kombisa MMK eka 1 USD = 5000 MMK (na USD tani hi layini ya vumbirhi). Nkarhi wo hakela na movha wa vukorhokeri swi hambanile na makete.
pricing_faq_a5: Cloud yi khomiwile Medora: SaaS ya swibedlhele swo tala, ku pfuxetiwa loku lawuriwaka, na ku sungula hi ku hatlisa. On-premise yi tirhisa ti tiers leti fanaka, leti vekiweke eka switirhisiwa swa wena loko u lava vulawuri kumbe vutshamo. Infra i ya wena; nxaxamelo wa n’hweti na n’hweti i Cloud + $150 eka vutihlamuleri byebyo.
